messages.speaker: me
messages.text: I was thinking about the trip, and I wondered whether we could push the dates back by a fortnight to make it less rushed for everyone involved.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: That does make sense to me, honestly. A fortnight would give us more breathing room, and I do not think the booking is quite as fixed as I had been assuming.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: I will look at what the cancellation terms actually are before we commit to anything, just so we both know what it costs us.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Good idea. My instinct is that the difference is small, but I would rather know the number than guess and then be surprised later on.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: I will send you the terms when I have dug them out, probably tomorrow once I have found the original email.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: No rush at all, and if the numbers are terrible we can always look at the other dates that were mentioned as a fallback option.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: The hotel said they can move us without any penalty at all, which is better than I expected given how early we originally booked everything.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: That is excellent news. It means we lose nothing by moving, so I will go ahead and rearrange the trains while you sort out the car hire.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: I will keep an eye on the dates of the car hire, because the quotes I saw last week have already gone up.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Let us not chase the car hire for now. The train is the more important booking, and if we get that sorted the rest can follow at a more relaxed pace.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: That is true, and the train prices are going up every week at the moment so that one does need doing.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Agreed, I will book the tickets this evening once the new dates are confirmed by the hotel in writing.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: It is booked, the new dates are in the diary and I have sent the confirmation to both of us so nobody is caught out.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Brilliant, thank you for taking that on. I will let the others know, and we can look at the restaurant bookings again once the dates have actually shifted.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Good plan, there is no rush now that the train is sorted out and everything else can follow on from there.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: I will keep an eye on the prices for the remaining bookings, but I would not lose sleep over it, they will not change dramatically.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: That is reassuring, and I will stop checking the price every morning if you think that is reasonable.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Please do, refreshing the page does not make the number go down, and I will keep you posted if anything material changes.
